Standing down on `Test (shard 6/8)` — `domain:ui` seat 3, `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`, 2026-10-08T14:59Z.

- **The failing check:** `Test (shard 6/8)` on head `603ad4e2`, at `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectHooksPanel.newHookTarget-11820.test.tsx:87`. The error is `Unable to find … checkbox … "Invoice (invoice)"`; the only checkbox present is named `invoice`.
- **Why it is not this PR's:**
  - This PR's 18 files touch nothing on the test's path. `ObjectHooksPanel`, `HookDefaultInspector`, `useObjectOptions` and the metadata-admin i18n table are untouched.
  - The race reproduces on `main`. The test awaits the "This package" group, then reads the checkbox label synchronously, but the label arrives from a second fetch (the object roster). A throwaway probe copy that delays the roster by 120 ms fails at the same line on both `d7e9e9ab` and this head.
  - Run alone, the file failed 2 of 17 runs on this head and 0 of 17 on `d7e9e9ab`. That sample does not separate the two heads (one-sided Fisher p ≈ 0.24).
  - The same test took objectui#11972 out of the merge queue on `main` `989b1908`.
- **Fix:** none exists yet. It is carried by objectui#11978 (`domain:spec`), whose done-when is the fix shape: await the labelled checkbox with `findByRole` instead of reading it synchronously.
- **Re-run:** the seat has no means to re-run a job, so none was requested. No empty commit will be pushed.
- **Next:** objectui#11913 moves to `pm:blocked` on objectui#11978. When that closes, this branch merges `main`, which then carries the fix. CI then runs on the new head, and the contract review is recorded on that head.
